body:
Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
当retrun_softmax为true时，存在softmax_max和softmax_sum精度问题
### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
组合包：/compilepackage/CI_Version/cann_eco/br_milan_torino_v100r001c10_main/202603/20260310_000554712_newest
子包：/compilepackage/CI_Version/cann_eco/br_milan_torino_v100r001c10_main/202603/20260314_000526683_newest
pta : 0309日
### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
下载aclnn测试工程
批跑命令（python3.9）：
./train_performance_pytorch_graph.sh --json_name=all_aclnnSparseFlashAttention_level0_nsa_torch_001.json --framework=pytorch_graph --python=3.9 --graphy_path=0 --with_bm=False --need_inf=True
批跑命令（非python3.9）：
./train_performance_pytorch_graph_obp.sh --json_name=all_aclnnSparseFlashAttention_level0_nsa_torch_001.json --framework=pytorch_graph --python=3.12 --graphy_path=0 --with_bm=False --need_inf=True
### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
精度正常
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)
